readme.summary: Private Rust/Bun monorepo: the Bun fork runtime (`yolo`), the Python runtime (`vu`), the `aphrody` CLI/MCP/FFI and the M3 UI framework.
layout: Build, product, host and deployment declarations
audit, build, dev, migration, release, tools

owners: Precompiled runtime and SDK (Bun fork + CLI, aliases `bun`, `vu`)
Sole owner of the `aphrody-rust` Python binding
`aphrody-kernel`: minimal TCB + subsystems; Linux/Asterinas/kernel32 provide the rest
targets: `aphrody` multicall binary (`apps/cli`, `crates/infra/aphrody-command`); former tool names are links

`aphrody-mcp` (`crates/ai/mcp`) is the only MCP server and hosts the kernel in process; `aphrody kernel mcp`, `yolo mcp` and `m3-mcp` are deprecated aliases (2026-10-07); `yolo tool` and the M3 `tool-host` are tool hosts, not servers
`vu` runtime (uv + ruff + PyO3 + shared CPython), plan in `docs/plans/vu/PLAN.md`
contracts: Versioned SDK and C ABI: opaque handles, sized structs, ABI/capability negotiation, length-carrying buffers, allocator-side release, explicit errors, cancellation, threading and lifetime rules.
Internal Rust types and engine rlibs are not the application ABI; a standard extension builds without rebuilding engines.
Every context, operation and resource has an owner. Bounded queues, explicit saturation; stop and join workers before unload; respect UI and JS-object threads.
Permissions, origin and isolation are enforced natively. Remote pages get no implicit Bun/host privilege; cookies and profiles stay isolated.
Preserve unwind/recovery at real artifact boundaries; isolate work that can fault memory.
Bun keeps JSC/WebKit, Obscura supplies V8/headless; V8 stays until Obscura/JSC parity. Qualify DOM, GC, exceptions, promises, microtasks, modules, workers, timers, interrupts and teardown.
Keep API/CLI/permission identities, licences, provenance, features and lockfiles. Remove a replaced path in the batch that qualifies its replacement.
Engines build per version/target; refuse an incompatible ABI before any native call.
npm `@aphrody` is the only package channel outside the monorepo; `workspace:*` inside it.
queue: Fold thin crates/packages into their owner (gates: clippy `-D warnings`, scoped tests on the VPS); root layout aligned on Tauri `dev`, Obscura and Bun `main` (`crates/ packages/ docs/ scripts/ tools/ vendor/ assets/ examples/ bench/ test/ patches/`); absorb `apps/ config/ data/ bin/ m3/ plugins/ py/`
`aphrody-mcp` is the only MCP server; `yolo mcp`, `m3-mcp` and kernel MCP become aliases; same-purpose tools merged
Target in `docs/plans/os-kernel/PLAN.md` (Asterinas `ostd`/`kernel/{core,comps,libs}`, Linux subsystems); replace hand-made coreutils/Nushell by `uutils`, `eza`, `sudo-rs` or Bun Shell
Remove agent-delegating commands (agy, antigravity, hermes, notebooklm…) and every command needing another executable; add maintained crates from crates.io to shrink the build
Cross-build `aphrody-ffi` (profile `runtime`), package, enable the artifact in `config/downloads.json`
Point `bun`/`yolo`/`vu` on PATH to the fork binary; Windows; embed `libaphrody_ffi`; `bun:ffi` binding
Verified artifact on a fresh machine without engine rebuild; install, upgrade, rollback
Windows installer for `aphrody-app`; real Windows run; rendering in the real CEF app
Restart `shenron-site`/`shenron-bot` after the release; measure `/api/chat`; verify the agent card
Finish `workspace/wip/infra-mcp-auth` (bearer, free port, `infra validate` fix), gate, rebase, push
Python/TS extractors and `scripts/audit/ai/graph-parity.ts`; Graphify stays the parity oracle
npm `@aphrody/*`, crates.io (316 crates: metadata, `publish = false`, path versions, 14 taken names), PyPI
Archive absorbed GitHub repos and integrated forks; deprecate absorbed npm packages; prune stale worktrees
`web:verify`, 4 `apps/yolo/cli` tests (`libaphrody_ffi` absent), `aphrody infra validate`, global typecheck
success: Changing a workflow, screen or integration does not rebuild engines.
A standard Rust extension builds against the light SDK.
Every native resource has an owner and a verified teardown; cancellation leaves no leak or dangling callback.
Page and extension rights are enforced natively.
Runtime and app compatibility, upgrade and rollback are qualified; heavy artifacts are precompiled per supported target.
Build, size and memory gains are measured separately; replaced paths are removed after qualification.
plan.receipts: Each closure cites revisions, target, commands, results, artifact and limits, and separates source, tests, packaging, installation and activation.

memory.intro: Dated evidence only. Decisions and queue live in PLAN.md; rules in AGENTS.md. History: `git log -- MEMORY.md`.

sections.title: Monorepo consolidation
rows: 13 thin crates folded into owners: gcs, shell → `aphrody-kernel`; ecosystem, summary, project-doc, exec-events, ai → `aphrody-command`; softraster, web-chromium, n2b-native, rag-ffi, python-ffi → `aphrody-ffi`; everything-sdk → `fsindex` (commits e8740a668, 3bb98f70b, 61438dd98). Clippy `-D warnings` clean; command 21, kernel 8, ffi 69+2, fsindex 26+1 tests passed on the VPS.
Dead code exposed by the folds was removed; Windows-only paths (`everything_sdk::win`, `chromium` cookies) are not compiled on Linux.
Target kernel architecture recorded from `aphrody git ingest` of Asterinas and the GitHub tree of Linux: `docs/plans/os-kernel/PLAN.md`.
Plan only; no folder regrouping done yet.

sections.title: Bun fork and absorption
rows: Contract `config/bun-absorb.json` + ratchet `scripts/audit/workspace/bun-absorb.ts`; 50 dead catalog entries removed. Fork resolves `picocolors`, `tiny-invariant`, `dotenv`, `uuid` natively (670 differential assertions identical).
At that date no fork build; installed Bun was official 1.4.2.
`aphrody-labs/bun` has one branch, `main` (upstream + Aphrody fixes); monorepo branches merged and deleted, only `main` remains.
Fork keeps 12,458 inherited remote branches (not deleted).

`main` `41a2ff302d` (upstream `3f1765a6de`): factory build 546 s, 156 `first_party` tests green, Bun 1.4.3; libm symbols rewritten to glibc 2.39 (`apps/yolo/forge/src/glibc.ts`), `elf-glibc-imports.ts --max 2.39` clean.
`/srv` on the factory was full; build ran with `BUN_FORGE_HOME` on the system disk.

Absorbed natively: `postgres`/`pg` → `Bun.SQL`, `vitest` → `bun:test`, `date-fns` → `Intl`, `fuse.js` → `@aphrody/fuzzy` (312 reference queries identical), `qrcode` → `@aphrody/qr` (208 symbols identical), `playwright-core` → `@aphrody/webview-page` (16 tests). Ratchet baseline `{}`.
No Kanji QR mode; fuzzy lacks extended search, logical queries, diacritic folding.
Single runtime `yolo` (fork `a4d88d124`: `argv0` aliases `bun`/`vu`, `dlopen(..., { global: true })`); `bun-forge --yolo-root` receipt green (569 s, 157 tests, sha256 `7c6b4c6e…5aa6`).
PATH links, Windows and embedded native tooling not activated.

sections.title: Python runtime `vu`
rows: `py/` merged; `crates/ai/rag-python` sole owner of `aphrody-rust`; wheel 788,600 B, 514 tests passed, 31 skipped; 42 duplicate files removed.
PyO3 pinned by the workspace lock (0.29.3).
Forks `aphrody-labs/{uv,ruff,pyo3}` pinned (`vu-pin-*`), `scripts/audit/workspace/vu-pins.ts` (6 tests, `--online` green).
No Aphrody patches; `uv-*`/`ruff_*` crates are internal.

`vu` artifact `0.1.0-cf385dd2` built and activated under `~/.vu` (cargo test 18, clippy `-D warnings`, glibc ≤ 2.39); Python version manager and `add|sync|run|lint|format|hf|compile` verbs; `yolo py` delegates. Peak memory: uv release 6.08 GiB / 20 min 38, ruff 2.72 GiB, vu 535 MiB.
No GPU validation; ×2 goal missed (python startup ×1.5, imports ×1.12, uv ×1.06, `uv sync` ×0.7).
Shared libpython: fork `a4d88d124` passes Bun → libpython → Rust extension; stock Bun fails (`undefined symbol: _Py_DecRef`).
Windows `python-ffi` open.

sections.title: Single binary, FFI, MCP
rows: `aphrody-mcp` serves 164 tools; `aphrody kernel mcp` 329; `yolo mcp` 14; `aphrody plugins validate` 0 issues.
Plugin repos kept on their remotes.
`bxc`, `bxc-mcp`, `n2b` are multicall names of `aphrody`; `aphrody-web-bridge` removed; `crates/web/x` is the sole X implementation (Web ABI 5).
Parity doc: `docs/migration/bxc-n2b-unification-2026-10-05.md`.
`aphrody` release installed (`--locked`, VPS, 3 min), `aphrody package doctor` 34/34 links.
Binary 370 MB unstripped vs 129 MB published.

Dedup: removed `aphrody-search`, `aphrody-settings`, `packages/compat/tsconfig.base.json`; 21 orphan Rust files (2,962 lines) and 20 uncalled scripts removed; `docs:check-links` green (was 149 broken links).
`aphrody-tools`/`aphrody-chat` deprecated but still called; `@aphrody/ovh` duplicates `aphrody-ovh`.
Removed 17 unreferenced one-off scripts (graph leaves, no inbound reference) and one duplicate docs mirror.
Only text references checked; no gate run.

sections.title: Desktop and UI
rows: `m3/` replaces `design/aphrody-m3/`; app-ui 216 tests / 991 assertions, build 641 files / 63,030,159 B; web server uses real app-server RPC/SSE.
Native Tauri rendering and full backend activation open.

CEF only: `aphrody-wry`, `-tao`, `-tauri-runtime-wry`, `-tauri-driver` removed (243 files); `gtk`, `webkit2gtk`, `wry`, `tao` absent from the graph. Linux #16189 busy loop: main thread 99.8% → 2.2–2.8% with fix.
Xvfb software rendering; remaining ≈24% tree CPU is animated UI.

Wry → CEF (release, Xvfb): processes 7 → 15, PSS 887–952 → 531–543 MiB, window mapped 182–231 → 435–443 ms; binary 217,085,720 → 225,646,408 B; CEF payload ≈548 MB; cold build 17 min 11 s → 22 min 26 s.
No deb/rpm measured.
One app: kit bridge `aphrody.kit/1`, routes `admin`/`creator`, `m3/apps/web` merged into showcase, `apps/yolo/web` into Studio › Engine; `Aphrody-Setup.exe`; app-ui 215 tests.
Unsigned exes; nothing run on physical Windows.

sections.title: Agent home and code graph
rows: `aphrody-store` (one SQLite per home, migrations 0001–0006), `aphrody-code-graph` (Rust tree-sitter, Louvain, query/path/explain), unified `aphrody home query` (chunks, nodes, memories, one RRF).
Lexical search only; no vector channel.
Graph parity vs Graphify on this repo: 105,977 nodes, 234,039 edges, 3,674 communities; node Jaccard 0.935; 1 of 55,000 functions missing.
Graphify remains the oracle until criteria P1–P6 pass.
Imports after dry-run: global home 14,331 memories, 720 sessions; dbfr 421 documents, 2,362 chunks; aphrody 37 memories.
Home sync is preview-first; `--apply` takes a verified backup.

sections.title: Infra, hosts, release
rows: Shenron/Koharu extracted to `aphrody-labs/shenron` (169 commits, 4,325 files); private state moved to `~/shenron` (6,181 files, SHA-256 verified). Host plan and `/api/v1/shenron/*` gateway stay in Infra.
Public opening pending audit of the local corpus.

vps CDN for dragonballfr.com: vhosts, hourly `shenron-cdn-sync.timer` from dbfr (21,067 + 66,690 + 286 files), HTTP/3 and TLS 1.3 `X25519MLKEM768` verified; lossless optimizer `scripts/release/cdn-optimize.ts` (PNG −13…−20%, br text −95%).
dbfr disk at 93%; `shenron-cdn` on dbfr has no pull.
Factory builds are installed atomically with SHA-256 and `--version` probe; VPS glibc 2.43 binaries are refused by WSL (2.39).
A glibc 2.39 target is still to declare.
Downloads published at downloads.aphrody.com; current release `20261006T191420Z-5bf7eed5a42c` (aphrody Linux+Windows, yolo Linux, plugins).
yolo Windows disabled.
Declared, not applied: `aphrody-mcp-http` (127.0.0.1:8789) and `aphrody-a2a` (127.0.0.1:8788) units; WireGuard `wg1` `10.200.77.0/24` and account `omar`.
Port 8789 is taken by sshd on the vps.
`@aphrody/a2a`: A2A 1.0.0 client (JSON-RPC, HTTP+JSON, SSE), 110 tests; Rust server spec gaps fixed in source (143 tests, clippy clean).
Installed binary unchanged.
Cloud session host: 4 CPU, 15 GB RAM, ~30 GB disk; scoped `-p <crate>` gates only.
Full workspace, V8, Tauri, WebKit builds go to the VPS.
CI jobs do not start (account billing).
Owner-side.
